notes:
- stack-plan.md:7: "lowest branch first" is missing from the owner text for the lagging-stack base merge. It appears only in version-control.md:12, requirements.md:34 (R-GIT) and dist holyagent.md:120. The report's claim that the full rule lives only in stack-plan.md is wrong for this clause. Add it to stack-plan.md:7, or reduce version-control.md:12 to a pointer.
- stack-plan.md:7: "the delivery's top branch" is undefined, and it differs from "the open stack's top" (stack-plan.md:3, version-control.md:10, requirements.md:8). version-control.md:10 names only "the open stack's top or the base". For a delivery whose first PR is a CI PR from the base, the second PR starts from that CI PR, which neither phrase names. "or its first PR's start branch" is also awkward, because before any PR exists there is no branch to name. Name the predecessor branch explicitly.
- stack-plan.md:3: the fork and others'-branch exclusion and its reason ("which the root cannot push to") were dropped. The boundary now survives only as "the owner's own non-draft PRs from branches of this repository" and in decisions.md:53. Restoring the short parenthetical would keep the trust boundary where the root reads it.
- docs/usage.md:96 agrees with the recorded behavior (new PRs, first included, start from the open stack's top; base only for CI, no open stack, or independent-PR conventions; independent review, not human review; base merged forward when lagging). It omits the tie-break "the one it depends on, else the most recently updated" and the lowest-first merge. That is an omission, not a contradiction. It also duplicates stack-plan.md:3-7, as does decisions.md:53 and :66. A pointer to the Stack plan would keep one owner.
- requirements.md:8: "the base cases" is undefined there and leans on "as the stack plan sets". Acceptable as a pointer.
- agents.ts:212, :218 and :258 still find their phrases: "stacks in work order by default" (stack-plan.md:3), "gets a review of that head before any push" (stack-plan.md:7), and "Never force-push, and never push to the base, default or a protected branch" (version-control.md:11).
- dist holyagent.md lines 122-135 match stack-plan.md:3-8 bullet for bullet.
